newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down on Tokyo's fall.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down on Tokyo's fall.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market was slightly lower at noon session on lack of buyers and falls in Tokyo market this morning, dealers said.
"The market is falling and the buyers do not want to commit themselves on speculation of cheaper levels," a dealer said.
Chinese buyers were looking to buy prompt SMR 20 at 250 cents but no business was done. Dealers expect the South Koreans to tender later today for SMR 10 and 20 and latex rubber.
Dealers said stocks were building up as there was no keen demand.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 320 cents, SMR L at 301, SMR 5 at 263 and latex at 218.
At midday, July RSS Ones buyer eased a cent to 273.50 cents ($1.09) a kg and July SMR 20 buyer was down half a cent at 252.
A Malaysia-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU (or 20-ft container), and $1,700 per two-TEU containers (or 40-ft container).
